messages:
alex.k: Heads up — keystore connection fanout spiked on a private deploy in eu-west, ~3k concurrent TLS handshakes and some 503s. Saw sudden traffic from one tenant.

maria.s: @alex.k can you paste the alert & the audit entry? do we think this is misconfigured client retry loop or a token leak?

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: keystore-conn-fanout high on cluster privedge-eu-4 — 3.1k established TLS connections, 18% errors, 503 @ 2026-03-15T10:12:03Z

alex.k: Here's a snippet from the audit stream:

sre-jen: ```
2026-03-15T10:11:58Z keystore.authenticate svcacct=tenant-123 action=GET key_id=k-9f8c result=FAILED reason="rate_limit_exceeded" src_ip=10.12.4.22
```

maria.s: looks like many distinct src_ip but same svcacct. Could be compromised service principal. KMS rotation in the short term?

kevin.t: Network mitigation first: apply a restrictive NetworkPolicy to limit ingress to the keystore service from known egress CIDRs + enforce mutual TLS. Quick NP example below:

kevin.t: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keystore-allow-clients
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: keystore
  ingress:
  - from:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.12.0.0/16
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: internal-services
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

sec-bot: Suggestion: add RBAC constraint to limit which ServiceAccounts can call keystore API — use OPA gate to detect anomalous SA usage.

sre-jen: For immediate mitigation: 1) add NP (kevin's) in staging, 2) create short-lived block rule on the LB to throttle the tenant IPs, 3) rotate the tenant's keys, 4) enable enhanced audit logging for keystore (verbose request/subject) for 72h.

alex.k: I kicked off rotation for tenant-123 keys, created ticket RW-54321. Enabled verbose audit; sampling where header x-forwarded-for exists.

maria.s: For longer term: add circuit-breaker to keystore client pool (backoff + jitter), and a server-side concurrent-connection cap per-tenant. Also we should add a signed attestation to private deploys to prevent rogue clients.

kevin.t: Also recommend adding per-tenant egress shaping on host level (tc) so tenant misbehaving doesn't impact other tenants.

sre-jen: Incident task list on RW-54321: [ ] NP rollout to prod canary, [ ] LB tenant throttle, [ ] key rotation, [ ] audit logs to SIEM, [ ] RBAC rule PR, [ ] postmortem. I'm taking NP rollout.

alex.k: quick note: when rotating keys with KMS, ensure we update keystore cache invalidation and KV cache TTLs — otherwise stale cache may still accept old tokens.

maria.s: Good catch. sec-bot can you open a follow-up for an RBAC policy review next sprint?

sec-bot: Created ticket RW-54322 — RBAC policy sweep for private deployments. Assigned to sec-team.

kevin.t: If anyone needs the LB block command: `gcloud compute forwarding-rules set-target ...` (we used a static deny route) — I can share exact snippet in thread if needed.

sre-jen: For the postmortem, capture timeline + netpol change perf impact, any latency regressions from keystore scaling. Keep it lean.

alex.k: Thanks all. Will paste the final logs to RW-54321 and close loop. :thumbsup:
